card.capacity_status_quote: Our backlog continues to grow given elevated demand and supply constraints, and this is reflected in the greater than 40% sequential growth we saw in our purchase commitments.
card.demand_direction_quote: Demand was even stronger than revenue growth. Orders more than doubled significantly outpacing revenue, resulting in a record company backlog.
card.pricing_power_quote: Sequentially, revenue grew 15%, reflecting higher average selling prices within our server business driven by ongoing DRAM and NAND inflationary costs and supply constraints. We continue to work with our partners to secure long term agreements while executing the pricing actions we discussed last quarter.
card.guidance_direction_quote: For fiscal year 26, we are raising our EPS range to $3.35 to $3.45 We are also raising our GAAP EPS range to $2.42 to $2.52.
card.constraint_owner_quote: When it comes down to potential upside on the revenue and the ability to convert that, it really comes down to availability of supply.
